package com.cowave.search.outbound_adapter.proxy.cache

import com.cowave.search.domain.proxy.category.Category
import com.cowave.search.domain.proxy.category.CategoryRepository
import com.cowave.search.repository.cache.tiered.TieredCache
import io.kotest.core.spec.style.FunSpec
import io.kotest.matchers.shouldBe
import io.mockk.every
import io.mockk.mockk
import io.mockk.slot
import io.mockk.verify

class CachingCategoryRepositoryTest : FunSpec({

    val category = Category(
        id = 1,
        name = "테스트",
        depth = 1,
        idPath = "1",
        namePath = "테스트",
        status = "USE",
    )

    context("findAllByIds") {
        test("캐시가 결과를 반환하면 delegate를 호출하지 않는다") {
            val delegate = mockk<CategoryRepository>()
            val cache = mockk<TieredCache<Int, Category>>()

            val fetcherSlot = slot<(List<Int>) -> List<Category>>()
            every { cache.getOrFetch(listOf(1), capture(fetcherSlot)) } returns listOf(category)

            val repository = CachingCategoryRepository(delegate, cache)
            val result = repository.findAllByIds(listOf(1))

            result shouldBe listOf(category)
            verify(exactly = 0) { delegate.findAllByIds(any()) }
        }

        test("캐시 미스 시 delegate의 findAllByIds를 호출한다") {
            val delegate = mockk<CategoryRepository>()
            val cache = mockk<TieredCache<Int, Category>>()

            every { cache.getOrFetch(listOf(1), any()) } answers {
                val fetcher = secondArg<(List<Int>) -> List<Category>>()
                fetcher(listOf(1))
            }
            every { delegate.findAllByIds(listOf(1)) } returns listOf(category)

            val repository = CachingCategoryRepository(delegate, cache)
            val result = repository.findAllByIds(listOf(1))

            result shouldBe listOf(category)
            verify(exactly = 1) { delegate.findAllByIds(listOf(1)) }
        }
    }
})
